scripts.title: Mey  Floor Auto Farm
scripts.features:
Basically just teleports to money that spawns on the floor
set "getgenv().lol" to false if u want to stop auto farm
also I'd recommend running a fly script so u don't fall to the void since
you do sometimes glitch and bug out and fall to the void soo ye
also use a anti afk script lol
scripts.script:
getgenv().lol = true -- set to false to disable
task.spawn(function()
        while true do wait()
            if not getgenv().lol then
                break
            end
            for i,v in pairs(workspace.Particles:WaitForChild("Money"):GetChildren()) do
                if v.Name == "Bundle" then
                    game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart").CFrame = v.CFrame
                end
            end
        end
end)
